# Union Bank of India (UNIONBANK) – BUY
## Target Price: ₹216 | Upside: 11.1%

**RECOMMENDATION SUMMARY**

Initiate coverage on Union Bank of India with a BUY rating and target price of ₹216, implying 11% upside from current levels of ₹194. The bank is executing a focused portfolio optimization strategy while delivering robust asset quality improvement, positioning it well for sustained profitability as India enters a benign credit environment with improving GDP growth and monetary easing.

**INVESTMENT CASE**

• **Superior asset quality trajectory**: GNPA improved 79 bps YoY to 3.06% with NNPA at sector-leading 0.51%, supported by exceptional provision coverage of 95.13% (up 171 bps YoY). SMA2 accounts at historic lows of ₹4,285 crores with 95% of corporate book rated BBB+, indicating minimal forward slippages. Credit cost contained at 9 bps with management guiding to 20-40 bps range even post-ECL transition.

• **Strategic NIM protection delivering results**: Despite 125 bps repo rate cuts, NIM improved sequentially to 2.76% through deliberate shedding of ₹38,000-40,000 crores in high-cost bulk deposits, treasury portfolio reduction of ₹15,000 crores, and exit from ₹20,000 crores IBPC portfolio. CASA ratio improved 140 bps QoQ to 34%, providing sustainable liability franchise strength.

• **Strong profitability metrics with capital buffer**: ROE of 17.09% and ROA of 1.35% demonstrate operational efficiency gains, while CAR of 16.49% provides adequate buffer for growth. RAM advances growth at 11.5% YoY (Retail +21.67%, MSME +19.75%) drives portfolio mix improvement, though offset by Agriculture segment decline of -5.39%.

• **Digital transformation and governance leadership**: Ranked 2nd among PSBs in EASE agenda with multiple technology awards including Best Bank Tech Award. Management implementing AI and robotic process automation to improve operating leverage, while 200-branch expansion plan targets underserved markets for deposit mobilization.

**KEY RISKS**

• **Elevated contingent liabilities**: At ₹6.06 lakh crores, contingent liabilities remain a concern, though improved PCR provides cushion. Low interest coverage ratio suggests limited earnings buffer during stress scenarios.

• **Asset growth challenges**: Loan growth of 7.13% lagging deposit growth decline of 3.36% indicates C/D optimization may constrain near-term earnings. Agriculture book contraction of -5.39% YoY reflects portfolio risks in this segment that warrant monitoring.

• **ECL transition uncertainty**: While management guides to only ₹4,200-4,300 crores incremental provision requirement, full implementation of draft ECL norms could pressure ongoing credit costs beyond current 20-40 bps guidance range.

**VALUATION**

At 1.13x P/BV, UNIONBANK trades below historical averages despite 17% ROE and improving asset quality trajectory. Target price of ₹216 implies 1.26x FY26E P/BV, reasonable given sector-leading NNPA, strong capital adequacy, and 50.7% profit CAGR over five years. Recommend accumulating on dips below ₹185.
